definitions.explanation: The financial means by which a person or household supports daily life. Focuses on the economic aspect of making a living rather than the occupation itself.

examples.japanese: {生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to make a living.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧⟦{共働|ともばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てている→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: The couple supports their livelihood with both spouses working.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなって→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えて→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: Since my father passed away, my mother has been supporting the family's livelihood on her own.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the expression {生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to make a living, to earn one's livelihood). The word focuses on the financial/economic side of sustaining life, unlike ⟦{生業|なりわい}→生業：13523_nariwai⟧ which emphasizes the type of work.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to make a living (most common pattern)
- {生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧: to support one's livelihood
- {生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共|とも}にする→共にする：18718_tomonisuru⟧: to share a household (live together financially)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to make a living
- {生計|せいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧: to maintain one's livelihood
- {生計|せいけい}⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: means of livelihood
- {生計|せいけい}{費|ひ}: living expenses
